fn sort(v: &Vec<Int>) -> Vec<Int> {
    let len = len(&v)
    let mut sorted = vec()
    for i in 0 < len {
        let mut min = v.get(i)
        for j in i < len {
            if v.get(j) < min {
                min = v.get(j)
            }
        }
        push(&mut, min)
    }
    sorted
}
